jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Team**

The Security team protects Anthropic's AI systems and maintains the trust of our users and society.

**About the Role**

At Anthropic, we are pioneering new frontiers in AI that have the potential to greatly benefit society. However, developing advanced AI also comes with risks if not properly safeguarded. As a Research Engineer, you'll help to safely advance the capabilities of our models in incident response, security analysis, vulnerability remediation, and other areas of defensive cybersecurity.

This role blends research and engineering, requiring you to both develop novel approaches and realize them in code. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and cybersecurity specialists across and outside Anthropic.

This role requires ML experience combined with domain expertise in cybersecurity. You might be an ML researcher with a history of cybersecurity work, or a security professional with a background in ML.

* Partner with researchers and safety teams across Anthropic to understand their analytical needs and build solutions

* Have experience with machine learning.
* Have experience in cybersecurity research.
* Have strong software engineering skills.
* Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation.
* Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Professional experience in security engineering, fuzzing, detection and response, or other applied defensive work.
* Experience participating in or building CTF competitions and cyber ranges.
* Academic research experience in cybersecurity or other experimental & research background.
* Familiarity with RL techniques and environments.
* Familiarity with LLM training methodologies.

jobs.title: Linguistic Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta's Reality Labs Wearables division is developing future products in augmented reality and virtual reality. Our work in conversational AI, computer vision, advanced optics, eye tracking, machine learning and reasoning will enable and empower consumers and businesses in new ways.As a Linguistic Engineer (LE), you will focus on helping deliver datasets, models, and knowledge that power the ML systems across all components in the multimodal assistant product, such as ASR/TTS, NLU, NLG, Dialog, LLMs, and Knowledge Graph. The Linguistic Engineer delivers datasets, consistent models and representations across languages and areas, as well as data infrastructure that powers the voice assistant product.The ideal candidate has demonstrated technical, analytical, and collaboration skills with experience in building datasets for ML applications. Experience as an ML practitioner is useful but not required as the role focuses on the datasets and provides an opportunity to interface and work directly with ML teams as part of the greater voice assistant organization.Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics is needed for this role. The ideal candidate will have experience working with multilingual datasets or multilingual NLP systems, have an interest in NLP and/or conversational AI systems and being at the forefront of advancements in conversational AI systems. A plus is experience in any subfield of computational linguistics, though that is not specifically a requirement for the role.  
  
  

### **Linguistic Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Build datasets, pipelines, and models for ML applications
* Directly support product development with rules, prompts, and data patches
* Evaluate the quality of models and product experiences and close the feedback loop
* Clearly communicate with project stakeholders
* Identify and document repeatable practices for data quality, pipeline reliability, and model evaluation and improve procedures across data systems
* Drive and deliver projects from conceptualization through launch and beyond with continual improvement and support
* Design and conduct product experiments
* Identify and scope undefined problems, propose structured approaches, and deliver solutions with measurable outcomes
* Manage and prioritize concurrent work streams based on impact, deadlines, and stakeholder needs
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and data science

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience as data scientist, software engineer, computational linguist or in similar role
* Experience with programming and data analysis with languages and platforms such as Python, SQL, PHP/Hack
* Experience with text analysis, scripting, relational database, No SQL databases or similar
* Experience shipping multiple products across various platforms
* Degree in Linguistics, Computational Linguistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related fields, or equivalent experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Fluency in additional languages is preferred because the role involves building and evaluating multilingual datasets and models for the voice assistant product
* Experience designing and conducting data experiments
* Advanced coursework and/or research in Linguistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Information Systems, or related fields
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with version control, unit tests, and other programming best practices
* Experience with larger scripting projects that involve combining language data from different sources, computing complex metrics over large datasets, and so on

jobs.description:

You will be reporting to an Operations Research manager and this will be a hybrid role.

------------------

Operations Research Scientists on the Assignment team have the opportunity to dive into a wealth of logistics data, and use advanced optimization and machine learning techniques to maximize the value for our consumers, dashers, merchants, and DoorDash. You will be reporting to an Operations Research manager and this will be a hybrid role.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will...**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Design and implement new algorithm components within our production dispatching system to meet emerging requirements
* Integrate state-of-the-art optimization and machine learning techniques to improve the efficiency and quality of our dispatching decisions
* Extract insights from logistics system through analyzing data and modeling and translate those insights into production algorithm components
* Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product managers, business operators, and more to develop cross-cutting and scalable solutions to guide value for our consumers, dashers, and merchants

-----------------------------------------------

* PhD in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science, or a related field
* 2+ years of post-graduate research or industry experience in solving complex optimization problems using mathematical programming or metaheuristics

jobs.title: AI Research Scientist, SysML
jobs.description:
Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and wearable devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of Virtual and Augmented Reality require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will enable wearable devices, where our real and virtual world will mix and merge throughout the day. We believe the only way to achieve our goals is to look at the entire stack, from transistors, through architecture, firmware, and algorithms.Meta is seeking a Research Scientist to join our Research and Development teams. This role involves working on AI models, hardware acceleration, and software systems related topics. The position will involve taking these skills and applying them to solve for some of the most crucial and exciting problems that exist in Reality Labs. The primary objective will be to develop novel solutions that enable compute and power efficient training and on-device inference of vision and language models for use cases in AR, VR, and edge devices. We are hiring in multiple locations.  
  
  

### **AI Research Scientist, SysML Responsibilities:**

* Identify and solve multi-disciplinary ML acceleration problems spanning algorithms, model architecture, software, and hardware for AR, VR, and wearables use cases, often requiring novel approaches not yet established in the industry
* Invent and develop state-of-the-art model compression, efficiency, and scalability techniques, including numerics, pruning, distillation, speculative decoding, and memory-efficient transformer architectures, and benchmark them across diverse network classes. Integrate proven research into production ML infrastructure for broad adoption across the organization
* Post-train and optimize foundation models to deliver Pareto-optimal multimodal LLMs and GenAI models on our target hardware under real-time latency, power, and memory constraints
* Use models and algorithm insights to co-design next-generation hardware and system architectures, partnering with research scientists and silicon teams, and drive the algorithms and software integration needed to exploit these enhancements, applying in-depth knowledge of how ML acceleration interacts with surrounding systems
* Define use cases, methodology, and benchmarks to evaluate competing approaches, and influence partners to adopt recommended solutions through data-driven analysis and clear communication of trade-offs
* Stay at the forefront of efficient on-device ML research, and contribute to patents and publications in peer-reviewed conferences and journals

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* Experience developing AI-System infrastructure, AI algorithms or AI hardware acceleration in C/C++ or Python

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working and communicating cross-functionally in a team environment
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience or knowledge of architecting ML hardware accelerators and systems
* Experience or knowledge of post-training inference of Large scale GenAI/LLM models
* Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as publications at leading workshops, journals or conferences such as ICLR, NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, ICML, MLSys, ISCA, MICRO, DAC, ASPLOS etc
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience evaluating alternative system or algorithm designs by analyzing trade-offs in performance, power, and latency to recommend a solution
* Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar machine learning toolsets
* Demonstrated research and engineering experience via an internship, work experience, coding competitions, or widely used contributions in open source repositories (e.g. GitHub)
* Experience or knowledge of on-device algorithm development including hardware-aware ML models and/or optimizing ML compilers for efficient deployment on AI accelerators

jobs.description:
**About Latent Labs**
---------------------

For decades, drug discovery has relied on screening millions of molecules and hoping one works. Latent Labs is building the engineering alternative: frontier AI models that design medicines computationally, directly from first principles.

Since founding in 2023, we've released four products already accelerating research from pain relief to cancer therapy, most recently Latent-Y, the first lab-validated agent for drug design. Several of our team led foundational work behind Google DeepMind's AlphaFold, so we’re working at that level of research and beyond, backed by Radical Ventures and Sofinnova Partners.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking hands-on Scientists and a Sr. Scientist to join our team at the interface of generative AI and biology. Our models design novel proteins, and our experimental team develops and runs assays to characterize their properties and functions, identify strengths and failure modes, and guide subsequent model development.

**For both roles,** you will develop and execute high-throughput assays, drawing on a strong foundation in molecular biology, mammalian cell culture, and experimental design. We are looking for an adaptable scientist who selects methods based on the scientific question, brings depth in at least one relevant technical area, and enjoys learning new approaches. You will work closely with other experimental scientists, ML researchers, automation colleagues, and technical expert consultants to establish reliable workflows and generate high-quality, interpretable data.

**For the Sr. Scientist role,** on top of the scientist requirements, qualified applicants will have experience mentoring others in professional and technical context; additional years of industry experience; and experience managing complex projects with CROs, with full ownership including understanding SOWs, negotiating contracts, and troubleshooting.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Develop and run assays.** Independently design, execute, optimize, and troubleshoot cell-based and biochemical assays to evaluate model-generated proteins, with an emphasis on high-throughput plate-based workflows.
* **Establish new experimental capabilities.** Work with technical expert consultants to select and implement new assays, interpret unfamiliar data, and translate specialist knowledge into reproducible internal workflows.
* **Improve screening workflows.** Collaborate with the automation team to increase throughput, reproducibility, and efficiency, and contribute to the development of our screening platform.
* **Analyze and interpret results.** Use Python to process experimental data, assess assay quality, and communicate findings and limitations. Establish appropriate controls and QC criteria. Document methods, samples, experimental conditions, and analysis results using Benchling, a LIMS, or similar tools.
* **Connect experiments to model development.** Work with ML colleagues to provide well-documented data and biological context, and help translate results into actionable insights for subsequent design cycles.

**About you**
-------------

* **You have a strong scientific foundation.** You hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, or a related field, with at least 1-3 years of relevant industry research experience for Scientist; >3 years for Sr. Scientist. You can take an assay from initial feasibility testing through optimization and reproducible execution.
* **You have experience with high-throughput workflows.** You have developed or run high-throughput experiments, ideally using plate-based assays and laboratory automation. You understand how experimental design, controls, and sample handling affect data quality.
* **You bring practical molecular and cellular biology skills.** You have experience in molecular biology and mammalian cell culture, alongside relevant methods such as molecular cloning, cell-based functional assays, flow cytometry/FACS, ELISA, or next-generation sequencing. You do not need experience with every technique listed.
* **You are comfortable with large scale experimental data.** You are proficient in Python and Jupyter notebooks for data processing, analysis, and visualization, and can produce clear, reproducible analyses. You maintain accurate experimental records and have experience using Benchling, a LIMS, or comparable tools to track samples and associated data.
* **Relevant Technical Expertise.** We are looking for depth in **at least one** of the areas below, together with the ability and interest to learn adjacent methods. We do not expect expertise across all three.

  + Gene Editing and Protein–DNA Interaction Characterization

    - Experience developing biochemical and/or cell-based assays to characterize gene-editing technologies or protein–DNA interactions. Relevant experience may include measuring on-target editing efficiency, assessing off-target activity, or characterizing DNA-binding affinity and specificity.
  + Membrane Protein Characterization

    - Experience developing functional assays for membrane proteins, such as ion channels or solute carrier transporters. Relevant methods may include FLIPR assays, thallium flux, voltage-sensitive dyes, transporter activity assays, or manual or automated patch-clamp electrophysiology.

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* 2 years of experience in reinforcement learning, imitation learning, multimodal generative modeling, training and inference, and large vision, vision-language, video, and other multimodal models.
* 1 year of experience building generative architectures or world models applied to video, robotics, or interactive simulation environments.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Research Engineer on the Companion Robots team, you will train expressive, emotionally legible motion—including gait, gaze, posture, and gesture that change visibly with the robot's internal state—and develop the metrics to evaluate its effectiveness. You will work directly with animators and character designers, utilizing their expertise as a tuning pass and training signal, while building the evaluation harness required to compare behaviors, models, and robot platforms. Furthermore, you will collaborate with our state-of-the-art video generation and interaction models, such as Omni or Code Genie, to create systems capable of generating real-time expressive behavior in response to stimuli and internal motivations.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Clinical Outcomes
jobs.description:
Hybrid, *Palo Alto or San Francisco (Hybrid – 2 days/week in office)*  
*Reports to: Director Data Science + Analytics*  
*Job Type: Full-time W2*

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on Data Scientist to build and own the quantitative foundation for our clinical care delivery, patient treatment plan refinement, and retention engines.

  

In our specialty care model, clinical health outcomes and business growth are directly linked: matching patients to their preferred, personalized treatment path leads to higher clinical efficacy, better satisfaction, and long-term retention. In this role, you won't just work with clean tabular data; you will bridge the gap between structured clinical metrics (lab values, symptom severity scores, dosage trajectories) and unstructured patient communications (visit transcripts, ambient scribe outputs, and intake survey dialogue).

  

You will sit at the intersection of Data Science, Clinical Operations, and Product, serving as a core builder who transforms messy, multi-modal patient data into actionable clinical decision support and personalized care pathways.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Data Foundation & Pipeline Development**

* **Clean & Transform Multi-Modal Clinical Data:** Build reliable, well-structured modeling tables and feature stores by parsing, cleaning, and joining raw datasets including lab results, symptom severity surveys, medication history, and raw visit transcripts.
* **Establish Unstructured Data Workflows:** Design robust data processing pipelines to convert unstructured clinical notes, orders and visit transcripts into structured, queryable relational tables.

### **Transcript Mining & Feature Extraction**

* **Extract Patient Intent & Preference:** Build lightweight NLP and LLM-based pipelines (using entity extraction, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling) to convert ambient visit transcripts into structured features. And provide insights into patient preferences in treatment pathway, communication, and modality, etc.
* **Identify Friction Points:** Process qualitative dialogue to automatically detect unaddressed obstacles or early side-effect reports before they lead to treatment discontinuation.

### **Lookalike Cohorts & Patient Treatment Planning**

* **Lookalike Clustering Engine:** Develop unsupervised segmentation models to cluster patients into "lookalike" cohorts based on baseline lab values, symptom profiles, and transcript-derived preferences.
* **Outcome & Trajectory Forecasting:** Build predictive models that estimate symptom reduction, time-to-relief, and potential side-effect risks across alternative treatment branches (e.g., immediate HRT vs. conservative step-therapy).

### **Causal Inference & Retention Analytics**

* **Quasi-Experimentation on Care Protocols:** Apply observational study methods (Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, Survival Analysis) to evaluate non-randomized care pathways and quantify counterfactual patient outcomes.
* **Drop-Off & Retention Optimization:** Identify critical clinical touchpoints and dosage adjustment milestones that drive long-term program adherence, connecting clinical milestone achievement directly to patient retention and LTV.

### **Research & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Evidence Generation:** Partner with the clinical research team to provide analytical support for peer-reviewed medical publications, white papers, and payer studies.
* **Clinical Operations Alignment:** Translate analytical findings, treatment protocol insights, and patient drop-off trends into actionable workflow improvements for clinical operations and care teams.

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Technical Skills**

* **Programming & Querying:** Advanced proficiency in SQL for data manipulation alongside strong Python skills for predictive modeling and data transformation.
* **Machine Learning & Modeling:** Practical experience applying clustering (segmentation), regression/classification, and survival analysis (e.g., scikit-learn, statsmodels, lifelines).
* **NLP & Modern LLM Workflows:** Hands-on experience with NLP techniques and LLM frameworks (e.g., transformers, Claude API, etc.) to parse, extract, and classify unstructured text data.
* **Causal Inference Fundamentals:** Solid working knowledge of quasi-experimental design, propensity score matching, and counterfactual reasoning on observational datasets.

### **Analytical Capabilities**

* **Healthcare Data Intuition:** Comfort working with messy, semi-structured, or missing healthcare datasets (lab results, Patient-Reported Outcome Measures/PROMs, EHR notes).
* **Pragmatic "0-to-1" Builder Mindset:** You enjoy doing the foundational data architecture work—cleaning JSON outputs, structuring features, and validating baseline models—before reaching for complex algorithms.
* **Cross-Functional Communication:** Ability to translate technical modeling outcomes into clear, intuitive insights for Clinical Operations and Product partners.

### **Experience**

* 2 to 4 years of hands-on data science or analytics experience delivering high-impact solutions.
* Experience working with healthcare, telehealth, digital health datasets.
* Demonstrated track record of parsing unstructured text/transcript data into structured modeling pipelines.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biomedical Data Science, Health Informatics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.

#### **Interview Process:**

Recruiter Screen- 30 mins  
Hiring Manager Screen- 30 mins  
Technical Screen- 1hr  
Panel Interviews- 3 hours + Lunch in Office in Palo Alto

  

At this time, Midi is **unable to provide visa sponsorship**. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship needs.

*This is a full-time W2 position. The base salary range is* ***144K-172K*** *and will depend on experience. Midi pays a competitive base salary, plus equity and benefits.
